Interface Change<Self extends Change<Self>>

Type Parameters:
Self - The implementing type
All Superinterfaces:
Comparable<Self>
All Known Subinterfaces:
Change.Identified<Self>, Change.Value<V,Self>, Change.Value.Simple<V>
public interface Change<Self extends Change<Self>> extends Comparable<Self>
A change that can happen. This is typically used in the level system to hold the changes to be applied. You can use ChangeTypes to create your own instance
